glosses: A rocket-propelled firework or skyrocket, often one used as a signal (for example, to summon the crew of a lifeboat or warn of an air raid).

examples.text: On Sunday afternoon a serious firework explosion occurred in Lambeth, whereby three persons were seriously injured.
